name: kutt
description: Kutt is a modern URL shortener with support for custom domains. Shorten URLs, manage your links and view the click rate statistics. This container requires Redis a Postgres database and a functioning FQDN! Setup: 1. Install the Postgres container from your Apps tab. 2. Create a database an user. 3. Give the user permissions on the created database. 4. Install the Redis container from your Apps tab. 5. Setup an email account which Kutt can use. (technically optional but highly recommended!) 6. Setup an your preferred method of exposing Kutt to the outside world. 7. Fill out this template. Optional: 1. Setup Google Safe Browsing 2. Setup Google Analytics

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: IP of your Postgres instance

variables.name: Database port
variables.description: Port of your postgres instance

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: Name of your database. Make sure the database is already created and your user has the needed permissions!

variables.name: Database user
variables.description: Name of your database user

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: Password of your database user

variables.name: Database SSL
variables.description: Use SSL for database connection

variables.name: Redis host
variables.description: IP of your Redis instance

variables.name: Redis
variables.description: Port of your Redis instance

variables.name: Redis password
variables.description: Password for your Redis instance. Leave blank if you didn't set one!

variables.name: Mail host
variables.description: Hostname (FQDN or IP) of your mail provider. Used to send verification emails

variables.name: Mail port
variables.description: Port of your mail provider. 25 (unencrypted), 587 (TLS), 465 (SMTPS)

variables.name: Mail secure
variables.description: Set to true if using port 465

variables.name: Mail user
variables.description: Your email username. Most likely your email address

variables.name: Mail password
variables.description: Password of your email user

variables.name: Mail from
variables.description: Sender address

variables.name: Admin emails
variables.description: Comma seperated list of admin email adresses

variables.name: Report email
variables.description: The email address that will receive submitted reports

variables.name: Contact email
variables.description: Support email to show on the app

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: The domain that this website is on

variables.name: Site name
variables.description: The name of the site where Kutt is hosted

variables.name: Link length
variables.description: Generated link length

variables.name: Disable registration
variables.description: Disable registration

variables.name: Disable anonymous link creation
variables.description: Disable anonymous link creation

variables.name: Daily link limit
variables.description: Default limit for how many links a user can create per day

variables.name: Anonymous links cooldown
variables.description: Number of links anonymous users can create per minute. Ignored if anonymous link creation is disabled

variables.name: Max number of stats per link
variables.description: Max number of visits for each link to have detailed stats

variables.name: JSON Web Token key
variables.description: A passphrase to encrypt JWT. Use a long and secure key.

variables.name: reCaptcha site key
variables.description: Invisible reCaptcha key. Create one here https://www.google.com/recaptcha/intro/

variables.name: reCaptcha secret key
variables.description: Container Variable: RECAPTCHA_SECRET_KEY

variables.name: Google safe browsing key
variables.description: Google Cloud API to prevent from users from submitting malware URLs. Get one from https://developers.google.com/safe-browsing/v4/get-started

variables.name: Google Analytics key
variables.description: your GA key

variables.name: Google Analytics universal key
variables.description: Your universal GA key

variables.name: Internal port
variables.description: Internal application port. Do not change this!
